title: `os dev --no-compile` warns "this boot serves the STALE build", yet the public forms route serves the edited source
body:
## Finding

Found by the www.objectos.ai seat 1 during the 2026-11-09 rework of the anonymous public forms post (www PR #280). Measured on a real `@objectstack/cli` 18.3.0 scaffold carrying the CRM `crm_lead` object and its `web_to_lead` form.

- `os dev --no-compile` printed: `dist/objectstack.json is OLDER than your sources — this boot serves the STALE build`. At that moment the artifact still held `web_to_lead` with `enabled: false`.
- `GET /api/v1/forms/contact-us` answered **200**, matching the edited source (`enabled: true`), not the artifact.

So either the warning overstates what the boot serves, or the forms route resolves from config or source rather than from the compiled artifact. Both possibilities matter: an author who trusts the warning will misread what is live.

Seam: runtime `dev.ts:657` (staleness warning) ↔ `form-routes` `resolveFormBySlug`.

Reach: the public form door during `os dev`. No production claim.
